text:
Night clerk Luka Vukovic shut the municipal water desk in Podgorica and peeled this from a damp car-
bon set. Vendor Adriatic Pipeworks d.o.o. left bill AP-7714 dated 12 March 2026. I circled the money total they had already printed, 18440.50. The purchase-order line stayed blank after the courier shrugged at the rain. Old voucher AP-7701 for 902.00 was a prior leak repair and is not this bill. The meter cupboard still clicks, the stamp says PRIMLJENO, and a coffee ring sits on the lower corner.

vendor.instruction: Firm that issued this water note

text: Workshop lead Senait Berhe in Asmara tore this off a carbon pad once the generator coughed and died. Vendor Red Sea Diesel Yard raised bill RSD-3088 on 8 June 2026 and allowed 18 credit days, leaving the day cash falls due off this copy. Three charge lines are written: injector sleeve, gasket set, and shop labour. The amount boxed at the right, apart from those words, is 3184.75. Older slip RSD-3080 showed 410.00 for a different pump. Someone wrote in contanti, then the thumb smeared it.

boxed_amount.instruction: Figure printed in the amount box

pay_by.instruction: Raised date shifted by the credit days

text: Quarry secretary Anahit Grigoryan at the stone yard in Yerevan typed this after the lunch bell, with dust on the keys. Vendor Ararat Stone Supply issued bill ARS-5521 on 14 January 2027 and noted 45 days of credit in the margin, without dating the end of that stretch. The copied money figure in the total box is 9133.40. A faded earlier note ARS-5490 mentioned 1507.00 and was crossed in pencil. The account-code line stayed empty. The rubber stamp smeared across the fold, and the yard bell rang twice.

bill_number.instruction: Bill number typed on the sheet

pay_by.instruction: Margin date shifted by the credit days

boxed_amount.instruction: Figure copied from the total box

text: Recepcionista Mateo Quispe in La Paz wrote this with cold fingers before the cable car started. Vendor Illimani Glassworks bill IG-2146 is dated 3 August 2026. The crew clocked off at 4:15 pm. Hours 6.5 times the rate 48.40 were left for the office to multiply, and that product is not written on this sheet. Three boxes are ticked: pane cut, putty bead, and scaffold time. A stale quote of 190.00 from IG-2102 sat in the tray. Sello corrido, and the calle was still icy.

labour.instruction: Crew hours multiplied by the rate

text: Cashier Fatima Al-Busaidi at a tyre bay in Muscat jotted this between customers while the wall fan rattled. Vendor Gulf Rim Tyres bill GRT-883 was opened 4 November 2026 9:40. The paper date under the stamp is 19 November 2026. Gross 6400.00 minus the credit note 875.25 is for accounts to finish, and the difference is not on this sheet. An old scribble of 210.00 from GRT-790 was ignored. Shukran, the bay is dusty and the stamp slipped sideways onto the margin.

vendor.instruction: Tyre bay named on the jotting

balance.instruction: What remains after the credit note

text: Comptable Amina Dossou in Cotonou copied this from a wet ledger after the afternoon rain. Vendor Lagune Cold Store bill LCS-4419 is dated 22 July 2026. The three fee lines are 132.40, 58.15 and 27.80, and nobody wrote their addition on the page. The goods named beside them are ice blocks, crate hire, and night guard. A crossed old total of 64.00 from LCS-4401 is not this bill. Merci, the fan was off and the ink ran into the gutter. I left the blotter on the window ledge to dry.

goods.instruction: Each good named beside the fees

text:
Sigrid Moller, mast rigger, writing from the harbour shed in Nuuk once the fog lifted off the crane. Job NUK-3184 belongs to customer Qaqortoq Freight, whose coastal set went quiet just after midnight. I stayed on the iced rungs for 8.5 hours, and the rate card clipped beside the job says 63.20. An old quote of 480.65 was stapled under the clip; that slip is from another winter and I would not honour it. We buttoned the work up on 14 May 2026. Stamp: MODTAGET. The mate kept saying qujanaq while the winch squealed over the basin. Nobody clipped a purchase order to this copy. A tear split ru
ngs on the carbon, so the office sheet looks as if the ladder failed twice.

job_code.instruction: Job code printed on the Nuuk docket

labour.instruction: Hours multiplied by the rate on the card

finished.instruction: Date the mast work was buttoned up

purchase_order.instruction: Purchase order clipped to the docket

text:
Rain hammered the tin roof in Palikir and the gutter was already overflowing onto the step. Renato Halbert, radio tech, opened job PLK-5521 when the VHF stack hissed and the night operator refused the climb. I swapped the coax jumper, then a seized mast clamp, then the desiccant pack that had melted into grey paste. Time on the ladder came to 6 hours at the card rate of 48.15. Their quote, still pinned in the folder, reads 310.40, and that figure was never meant for this mast. I closed the docket on 3 June 2026. Stamp: FILED. The clerk pencilled kalahngan along the margin. Carbon broke the word lad
der, so the duplicate starts in the middle of a syllable.

job_code.instruction: Job code for the Palikir radio job

parts.instruction: Each part that got swapped on the mast

labour.instruction: Ladder hours multiplied by the card rate

closed_on.instruction: Date the radio docket was closed

text:
The ferry horn kept cutting across the yard while Lagi Tuala, linesman, sat in the Apia depot with a soaked envelope. Job API-7742 had bled ink at the corner. I logged salt crust on the lug, a cracked gland, and a loose earth braid that sparked once the load came back. The slip shows a gross of 640.80 set against a credit of 115.30, and I left the remainder off the page. The case was opened on 8 April 2026 and shut again on 27 April 2026. Old docket API-6610 sits in the same drawer and belongs to another feeder. Stamp: LOGGED. The watchman said faafetai as he locked the gate. The sheet ripped through gl
and, so the word is split across the tear.

job_code.instruction: Job code on the Apia fault slip

faults.instruction: Each fault logged on the slip

remainder.instruction: Gross figure minus the credit note

open_span.instruction: How many days passed between opening and closing

text:
Erita Ioane, beacon keeper, writing in the south shed on Tarawa after the lagoon finally went flat and the skiff could tie up. Job TRW-4418 covers the outer light past the reef. I worked the tasks in this order: reset the beacon timer, scrape coral off the base, reseat the solar plug, and paint the tide mark. That round was finished on 19 August 2026. The permit square on the card is still empty. Stamp: SEEN. An older card marked TRW-2201 belongs to a different beacon and stayed in the tin. The boatman called ko rabwa as he pushed off the jetty. Carbon tore bea
con apart, so the office copy looks unfinished and salty.

job_code.instruction: Job code for the Tarawa beacon

tasks.instruction: Each task done on the outer light

finished.instruction: Date the beacon round was finished

permit.instruction: Permit number written on the card

text:
Caleb Joseph, cable jointer, from the river pit in Roseau once the water had dropped below the joint and the mud could hold a boot. Job ROS-7731 is the splice we had to cut open again. We first went into the pit on 2 February 2026 and we packed the joint and left on 20 February 2026. I am not writing how long we were down there. The wet folder also holds old ticket DOM-5504, which is the bath road job and not this pit. Stamp: PIT-OK. A neighbour leaned on the fence and said mesi, then nothing else. The carbon split jo
int, so the duplicate reads like two scraps of the same word. The ministry book is still in Portsmouth.

job_code.instruction: Job code for the Roseau river pit

opened_on.instruction: Date the pit was first cut open

closed_on.instruction: Date the pit was packed and left

on_site.instruction: How many days passed between cutting in and packing up

text:
Inez Castillo, stores clerk, in the Belmopan cage with the fluorescent tube buzzing and a moth trapped in the shade. Job BMP-6309 covers the western run out past the river. I handed across tie wire, bitumen tape, and one warning flag still in its paper sleeve. The three lines on the charge strip read 42.15, 18.60 and 27.40, and I did not add them anywhere on the page. Last month this cage rolled up 73.90, a different issue entirely. The book was signed on 11 November 2026. Stamp: ISSUED. The driver muttered ya esta, took the flag, and left the gate open. The sheet tore through warn
ing, so the last item sits in two pieces.

job_code.instruction: Job code on the Belmopan stores issue

kit.instruction: Each item handed across the counter

lines_sum.instruction: The three charge lines added together

issued_on.instruction: Date the stores book was signed

text:
Awa Jallow, quay clerk, turned a tide card over and copied the stall rents she had just read off the painted board in Banjul. Walking from the ferry ramp toward the fish sheds, she took them in this order: 3400, 1800, 4200, 2750, 2100, 3800, 2400 and 3050. She would not pencil a centre figure on the card itself. An older chalk quote of 2650 still ghosts under the split kiosk and is the wrong one. Stamp along the damp edge reads BJ-HARBOUR / RECEI
VED, the last letters walking into the fibre. Jërëjëf to the night watch, who held the lamp while she copied. The boarded kiosk by the ramp stayed shut, lock rusted since the spring tides.

estimate.instruction: Stall rent centred on the eight quay figures.

place.instruction: Harbour town written on the tide card.

text: Djeny Silva, tile setter, waited on the grout and photographed a shop-rent board while she was up in Praia, on the plateau rather than down at the port. Four figures came off the board before the paper curled: 1180, 640, 960 and 820. Valor antigo riscado: 740, a scratched guess she refuses to carry forward. The photo OCR split a word as recei pt across the crease. She wants the central shop rent from those four and has kept every total off this slip. Cutter dust speckles the corner, and a thumbprint covers the shop that closed when the owner moved inland.

estimate.instruction: Shop rent centred on the four board figures.

place.instruction: Plateau city named on the curled board.

text: Fazul Mohamed, pharmacy courier, listed the bench fees he was shown around Moroni and put the day on the chit as 18 March 2026. Six slips, none of them added together: 280, 125, 230, 340, 160 and 190. Bon pour accord was written and then crossed out; the crossed guess said 175, and he will not stand behind it. Stamp KM-CLINIC is sliced off at the right edge. He still needs the centred bench fee, and the stamped day, kept as two separate notes. The afternoon ferry hooted while a nurse told him to lift his elbow off the wet ink.

estimate.instruction: Bench fee centred on the six clinic slips.

place.instruction: Town named beside the clinic stamp.

noted_on.instruction: Day written on the clinic chit.

text:
Sina Teakava, weather clerk, kept the school rain gauge for the islet office in Funafuti. Fakafetai to the children who shouted the millimetres up the concrete step. She types one reading on its own line and leaves the later lines on the carbon copy only. An old drill code FT-88 is not a reading, and last season's stray tally of 109 must not be borrowed. Stamp MET-ATOLL smeared when the book shut on a damp thumb. The bucket is dented on the sea side, so she reads the meniscus at the undented lip.
2026-04-02|118
2026-04-05|126
2026-04-08|133
2026-04-11|141
2026-04-14|149

forecast.instruction: Next three school-gauge readings, in order.

place.instruction: Islet office town on the gauge book.

text:
Lina de Brum, radio operator, counted people stepping off the lagoon boat at Majuro. Iakwe on the morning net, then straight onto the tally sheet. Each count stands on its own line. A cancelled Friday had been guessed at 58 and then struck through; that scratch stays unmarked, beside code MH-27 from a different boat. The photo OCR left a gap inside passen gers. She will not copy the struck guess into the live column, and the late boat does not get a made-up figure.
2026-05-03|64
2026-05-06|71
2026-05-09|78
2026-05-12|83
2026-05-15|91

forecast.instruction: Next two lagoon-boat passenger counts, in order.

place.instruction: Lagoon town on the radio tally.

text:
Petra Frick, archivist, counted visitors through the small gallery door in Vaduz. Zur Kenntnis of the front desk: these lines are not to be added up. A holiday brochure claimed 19 for a wet Monday, and that leaflet is the decoy, left unmarked next to code FL-26. The scanner broke a word as gal
lery on the carbon. One line is one afternoon. The later afternoons stay on the copy she locked in the drawer, key on the red ribbon, and she will not invent them here.
2026-07-01|23
2026-07-04|29
2026-07-07|34
2026-07-10|38
2026-07-13|42

forecast.instruction: Next three gallery-door counts, in order.

text:
I am Ragnar Sigfusson, a ceramics student, writing from a cold kitchen in Reykjavik because the night bell never rang. Please use case RV-6184, the one pencilled above the kettle. The lobby board still shows old case RV-6180, which is not mine. Three things failed: the stair lamp flickered, the radiator valve stuck shut, and the door chime stayed mute. I send this on 11 June 2026. Afsakið the blur. A rubber stamp says NIGHT LOFT and the scanner split chi
me across one line. I left no locker pin here. Please answer before the harbour walk on Sunday. The kettle whistled the whole time I wrote this, which did not help.

case_code.instruction: Case code the customer wants used

faults.instruction: Each thing that failed that night

sent_on.instruction: Date the customer sent this message

locker_pin.instruction: Locker pin if the customer wrote one

text:
My name is Oyunbileg Dorj. I teach embroidery, and I am writing from the reading room in Ulaanbaatar after the lamps dimmed. My ticket is UB-2745. The desk blotter still shows ticket UB-2749 from last winter, so please do not mix them up. I need three shelves checked before I travel: felt maps, camel bells, and ink stones. This note is dated 4 August 2027. Bayarlalaa for the trouble. A stamp reads EAST DESK and the copier cut shel
ves in two. I did not write a courier slip. River wind drowned the last line of my recording. Please leave the reply with the east stair monitor.

ticket.instruction: Ticket the customer asked the desk to use

shelves.instruction: Each shelf item the customer wants checked

noted_on.instruction: Date written on the customer note

courier_slip.instruction: Courier slip if the customer supplied one

text:
Chantal Wijngaarde, receptionist at the river clinic in Paramaribo, logged the radio after the night storm soaked the porch. The live ticket is PM-4618. An old sticker on the casing still reads PM-4612 and must be left alone. We opened the job on 3 February 2026 and closed it on 28 February 2026. I filed this page on 1 March 2026. Alvast bedankt to the night nurse. A purple stamp says WARD B and the scan broke anten
na down the middle. No bin label was written on the folder. Humidity curled the lower corner before anyone could sign. The porch mats are still damp if anyone goes looking for the set.

open_span.instruction: How many days the radio job stayed open

bin_label.instruction: Bin label if one was written on the folder

text:
Tomas Shikongo, yard clerk in Windhoek, wrote this after the pump came apart on the south ramp. Use ticket WH-3904. The bin lid still shows WH-3907 from a scrapped visit, and that older quote of 31.40 is not for today. He fitted a gasket, a brass nipple, and a felt washer. The three pad lines, in NAD, are 12.45, 8.30, and 6.15. The sheet is dated 17 September 2026. Asseblief keep it with the south bay file. A stamp says YARD COPY and the copier split wash
er at the fold. The pump sits on blocks until the south ramp dries.

ticket.instruction: Live ticket for this yard visit

parts.instruction: Each piece fitted on the pump

pad_sum.instruction: The three pad lines added together

sheet_date.instruction: Date written on the yard sheet

text:
Karma Lhamo, archive assistant in Thimphu, kept this docket beside the cedar cabinet after the morning bell. The bundle code is TH-5513. A faded tab reads TH-5518 and belongs to another set of papers. She drew out a prayer map, an ink recipe, and a cedar tally. The bundle was opened on 6 April 2026 and shut on 2 May 2026. She signed the docket on 9 May 2026. Kuzuzangpo to the monk who waited at the gate. No donor seal appears anywhere. A stamp says INNER ROOM and the machine split tal
ly across the crease. Cedar dust is still on the blotter from the cabinet.

bundle.instruction: Bundle code written on the docket

leaves.instruction: Each leaf drawn from the bundle

held_for.instruction: How many days the bundle stayed open

donor_seal.instruction: Donor seal if one was on the folder

text:
Litia Vakacegu, fitter at the boat shed in Suva, wrote this once the lamp was seated for the night run. The job code is SV-7821. A blotter line shows SV-7826 and a stray quote of 58.15 that nobody here will honour. She changed a stern lamp, a coil lead, and a rubber boot. Bench time was 8.25 hours at 7.40 an hour. The chit is dated 22 November 2026. Vinaka to the crew who held the torch. A wet stamp says SHED TWO and the scan split tor
ch at the edge. The tide card stayed in the drawer. The lamp glass is wrapped in a cloth on the bench.

job_code.instruction: Job code on the shed clipboard

parts.instruction: Each piece changed on the boat

labour.instruction: Bench hours multiplied by the hourly figure

chit_date.instruction: Date written on the shed chit
